name: Hot-Path Bench Harness

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: native release build, criterion benches (macOS arm64)
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Hot-Path Bench Harness Hypothesis

### Hypothesis

The existing benches cover construction-heavy scenarios only; adding a `hot_paths` criterion bench that measures one write into an already-built pipeline (signal set/get, computed chain, effect, cache update with connect/filter/transform+bind, list push/insert/remove with bind/filter+transform/sort) and whole-pipeline loads gives trustworthy per-write numbers for the following experiments.

### Scope Lock

**Tested mechanism:** measurement enablement (new bench target only).
**Allowed changes:** `crates/benches/hot_paths.rs`, the `[[bench]]` entry in `crates/Cargo.toml`.
**Forbidden in this experiment:** any production source change or optimization.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement Plan

`cargo bench -p dxn_reactive --all-features --bench hot_paths -- --save-baseline base --warm-up-time 1 --measurement-time 2 --noplot`. Pass: the bench compiles, passes clippy (`--all-targets -D warnings`) and fmt, and every point reports a stable median.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected Outcome

A per-write baseline for the hot paths; no production behavior change.
reportMarkdown:
## Hot-Path Bench Harness Finished

**Index:** 2
**Checkpoint:** 6f40243
**Attempt Count:** 1

### Report

**Passed Status**: true — the new `hot_paths` bench builds, passes clippy/fmt, and reports stable medians.

### Scope Lock

**Tested mechanism:** measurement enablement.
**Out-of-scope changes:** none.

### Measurements (new baseline)

| Bench | Median |
| --- | ---: |
| scalar-hot/signal-set-no-subscribers | 11.221 ns median |
| scalar-hot/signal-set-one-subscriber | 28.019 ns median |
| scalar-hot/signal-get | 3.9357 ns median |
| scalar-hot/computed-chain-8-set-and-get | 1.8227 µs median |
| scalar-hot/effect-on-filtered-map | 28.564 ns median |
| cache-hot/update-no-subscribers | 136.10 ns median |
| cache-hot/update-connect | 138.65 ns median |
| cache-hot/update-filter-half | 25.278 µs median |
| cache-hot/update-transform-bind | 9.3551 µs median |
| cache-hot/load-filter-transform-bind/10000 | 2.9832 ms median |
| list-hot/push-remove-no-subscribers | 235.30 ns median |
| list-hot/push-remove-bind | 264.79 ns median |
| list-hot/insert-remove-mid-filter-transform | 6.6129 µs median |
| list-hot/insert-remove-sort | 5.3586 µs median |
| list-hot/load-filter-transform-bind/10000 | 30.878 µs median |

### Findings

- A filtered cache update costs 25 µs at 10k rows (O(n) visible-index scan), transform+bind 9.4 µs per update.
- Loading 10k rows through cache filter→transform→bind costs 2.98 ms (≈300 ns/row) versus 31 µs for the list equivalent.
- List insert/remove in the middle with filter+transform costs 6.6 µs; with sort 5.4 µs.
decisionMarkdown:
### Decision

Committed success: the bench is the per-write measurement baseline for later experiments.
